Spring 2027 Internship: This position is located at our HQ in Durham, NC (Research Triangle Park).  Expected program dates are January 19 – April 23, 2027. Anticipated working hours will be 15-30 per week. Final hours and schedule will be determined between the intern and their manager.
Note : Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. Therefore, in order to be considered for this position, you must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship.
Our team is seeking an intern to support software engineering and hardware test engineering initiatives. Candidates will contribute to improving firmware update tools, deployment scripts, security-patch processes, and product qualification testing.
What You’ll Work On:
Priority 1 – Computer Science / Software Engineering
Update the CHEC firmware update process to support individual device selection
Update cash package scripts and the supporting file structure to include required files related to the core unit controller
Modernize the scripts used to download Windows security patches from Microsoft
Document changes and collaborate with CHEC-HW team members during implementation and validation.
Priority 2 – Test Engineering
Execute test plans to qualify foreign currency for CHEC-HW
Record test results and communicate defects, anomalies, and risks to the engineering team
Provide feedback on test processes to support optimization and quality improvements
Collaborate with team members to clarify procedures and improve repeatability
Required Qualifications:
Must be able to work on-site at our Durham, NC headquarters at least one day per week; two days in-person preferred.
Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Programming background with scripting experience in C++, Java, Python, and Windows batch scripting
Ability to understand existing scripts, file structures, and software deployment processes
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and written communication skills
Ability to read a test plan, follow documented procedures, and execute assigned tasks accurately
Dependable and trustworthy, with strong attention to detail
Reliable transportation and the ability to work on site at the RTP headquarters
Ability to clearly document test results, observations, and issues
